{{Quote|It can fry all the machinery on a starship without giving the crew so much as a hangnail!|Admiral Revald|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Null Cannons''' were a type of [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It functioned by firing energy blasts that completely disabled enemy technology such as [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. A prototype was present amongst the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] fleet at [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] before they crashed on the planet during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|battle]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

There they remained until a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] initiative on the planet led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Revald]] sought to reclaim the weapon for use against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. This operation was aided by a notable Republic citizen but faced opposition from the local [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that intended to claim the weapon for themselves. Pirate [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sero]] was involved with making numerous replicas of the Null Cannon during this time with the intention of distributing them amongst his forces. Sero attempted to negotiate trading the cannons to the Republic, but a surprise back up strike team made him believe the negotiators had betrayed him and attacked but was defeated.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
After defeating Captain Sero, the player(s) have the choice of destroying all the Null Cannons, leaving the Republic months to rebuild the prototype (light side dialogue), or try to preserve them all (dark side choice).<ref name="TOR" />

For players who side with the Republic in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]] storyline, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daeruun]] mentions that Admiral Revald has several Null Cannons prototypes created but are too unstable to be used in the Battle of Corellia.
